measurement: After 96abb4231 the two history-by-own-name pairs exit 0 and no longer hang, but both mismatch Java, as they do on the base 5e59b0421 (16 and 26 differences in the checker's DE score). The Java SVG draws the owner (Bailey, Chancel.Tympanum) as a GroupMakerState image. Inside the region it draws the new group Bailey.CONC2.CONC2 as class=cluster with id ent0002, the H pseudo-state inside it, and a link lnk4 whose data-entity-1 is ent0003. Rust falls back to the flat path, because build_state_group_outcome returns None for a group whose only leaf is a pseudo-state. A trial that keeps that group as a cluster matches every element except those ids (Rust ent0004 for the cluster, ent0002 for the link's source, lnk3).

java.cluster: The group's only leaf is the history pseudo-state, and its link to Pantry leaves the group. EntityUtils.isPureInnerLink3 fails, so Entity.isAutarkic is false (Entity.java:702-704). CucaDiagramSimplifierState does not image it (CucaDiagramSimplifierState.java:56-66), and the owner's GroupMakerState inner diagram draws it with Cluster.drawU.
java.uid: Entity uids come from CucaDiagram.cpt1 (getUniqueSequenceValue, CucaDiagram.java:808-810), which startingPass resets to 1 at each pass (CucaDiagram.java:159-165). The history group is created in pass two by getHistorical's gotoGroup (StateDiagram.java:142-156, CucaDiagram.gotoGroup :343-360) immediately before reallyCreateLeaf creates the pseudo-state, and then the Link takes the next uid. So the group is ent0002, the pseudo-state ent0003, and the link lnk4. Solar keeps its pass-one ent0003; the resets let uids from different passes coincide.

rust_divergence: build_state_group_outcome requires at least one State child. allocate_state_svg_ids gives pass-two uids only to link endpoints, so a group created by getHistorical in pass two falls to the leftover loop after every link.
planned_change: Renderer only. (1) In build_state_group_outcome, a group with no State children that still owns a pseudo-state endpoint, has no separator, and is not autarkic is a Cluster with no image children. (2) In allocate_state_svg_ids, for an [H]X or [H*]X endpoint whose group X has no uid yet, give X the next pass-two uid before the pseudo-state. Groups declared in pass one keep their pass-one uids.
